purpose: Replace low-precision keyword retrieval with exact DOI seeds before any citation expansion.

requirements: Resolve at least 8 of 10 exact DOI seeds in OpenAlex.
Preserve DOI-level deduplication and exact-seed provenance.
Inspect every resolved seed against its target claim family.
Do not expand references or retrieve full text without a later approval.

seeds.title: Hyperproperties
seeds.rationale: Foundational formulation of relational trace properties and secure information flow; tests whether observation equivalence is already standard in verification language.

seeds.title: Testing noninterference, quickly
seeds.rationale: Connects noninterference to executable testing and complexity limits rather than treating factorization as an isolated identity.

seeds.title: To SAT or Not to SAT: Scalable Exploration of Functional Dependency
seeds.rationale: Uses the same composition form f = h(g1,...,gn) in Boolean circuits and supplies the closest direct terminology match found in revision 2.

seeds.title: Scalable exploration of functional dependency by interpolation and incremental SAT solving
seeds.rationale: Earlier SAT/interpolation treatment of Boolean functional dependency; likely prior art for the decision mechanism even if not the succinct complexity classification.

seeds.title: Functional Decomposition and Switching Circuit Design
seeds.rationale: Foundational switching-circuit decomposition work; tests whether the factorization criterion is a restatement of classical functional decomposition.

seeds.title: A Functional Canonical Form
seeds.rationale: Early canonical-form treatment cited by later Ashenhurst-Curtis decomposition literature.

seeds.title: Equivalent Comparisons of Experiments
seeds.rationale: Foundational Blackwell comparison result linking information structures to attainable risk across decision problems.

seeds.title: Comparison of Statistical Experiments
seeds.rationale: Monograph-level treatment of deficiency, sufficiency, and experiment comparison for the finite Bayes-risk audit.

seeds.title: Coding for computing
seeds.rationale: Directly separates function recoverability from the number of communicated bits using characteristic graph entropy.

seeds.title: Representable Markov categories and comparison of statistical experiments in categorical probability
seeds.rationale: Modern categorical account of comparison of statistical experiments; useful for detecting whether factorization claims merely repackage sufficiency or garbling orders.

falsifiers: If classical functional-decomposition literature states the same fiber-constancy criterion in equivalent form, T-01 is not novel as a theorem.
If circuit functional-dependency literature already classifies the same succinct decision problem as coNP-complete or its complement as NP-complete, T-11 is not novel.
If Blackwell or deficiency theory already yields the finite Bayes-risk decomposition under the same assumptions, T-BAYES is an application rather than a new theorem.
If distributed function-computation literature already formalizes the local/joint observation distinction, T-03 should be reframed as synthesis, not novelty.
